newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends near lows despite late bounce.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends near lows despite late bounce.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended near the day's lows, despite a currency inspired bounce later in the session, traders said.
Active May last traded at 856 stg, 12 stg lower and just off its low of 855 stg.
But a possible assault on support at 847 stg had failed to materialise.
In the afternoon, the market looked more stable after sterling gave back most of its gains against the mark and came off highs against the French franc, one trader said.
But the afternoon's bounce just showed that the market could not go down in a straight line.
New York had helped London stabilise, he said. Currency fluctuations also played a part in New York's impact on London, colouring players' interpretation of New York moves.
London's afternoon volume was inflated by a high proportion of trade against switches and crosses, traders said.
Of a total volume of 15,716 lots, 6,169 were on May.
